The trail is pristine and a real treat. The hike is entirely in the shade of the forest so ideal for a hot summer’s day. There are short parts of the trail which are closed. Some places are muddy. For the most the trail is easily navigable.

I completed the hike using a walking stick which I found to be helpful in places where there are steeper inclines/descents. 

There are bugs aplenty so make sure to use bug repellant and keep some with you.

It is a great loop. There are 2 sections of this trail that are marked closed. The section from Rattlesnake to 12 Sideroad and the section from Walkers Line to the top of the escarpment on the Crawford Lake side of the valley.  There are some rocky sections at the top of the Crawford side that can be difficult to navigate without good footwear. Otherwise it is a really nice hike with beautiful lookouts.
